answer: Ploughing match association tenure with match entry logs is the check: matches entered with one association across seasons. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The prism signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 396 aliases needs 396 separate entry logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The quartz ledger records each payment, the wharf window resets the board, and 396 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
